title: Lead Mobile Developer
description:
**ABOUT COMPANY**

**NextGenTechs** is a future-forward technology company accelerating digital transformation through advanced AI-driven products and platforms. Our offerings include AI-powered Learning Management Systems (LMS), GenAI commerce tools, OTT & booking platforms, and custom app development. Trusted by top enterprises and public sector entities across the UK, India, and the Middle East, we bring innovation, compliance, and scale together.

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

As the Lead Mobile Developer in our Development team, you will drive the technical vision and execution of high-quality, secure, and performant mobile applications within the Information Technology domain. You will set engineering standards, own the mobile architecture, and mentor a team of developers to deliver robust solutions that meet business and user needs. Your role involves hands-on leadership, technical decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure seamless delivery and continuous improvement of our mobile products.

· Own and define the mobile application architecture, technical roadmap, coding standards, and engineering quality benchmarks.

· Lead the end-to-end development of production-grade mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, native iOS/Android, or other agreed technology stacks.

· Design and implement robust integrations with REST/GraphQL APIs, authentication systems, push notifications, analytics, secure storage, and backend services.

· Establish and enforce patterns for state management, offline capabilities, error handling, security, observability, and automated testing.

· Drive code reviews, ensure release readiness, manage app-store deployments, monitor crashes/performance, and resolve incidents efficiently.

· Collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, QA, DevOps, and security teams to deliver reliable, end-to-end user experiences.

· Continuously improve build pipelines, automated testing frameworks, release automation, application performance, and developer productivity.

· Mentor and coach developers, plan technical work, support estimation, and proactively manage delivery risks.

· Champion best practices in mobile engineering, security, and compliance, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and ready for real-world use.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**WORK EXPERIENCE**

· Minimum 5 years of professional experience in mobile application development, with proven expertise in at least one modern mobile technology stack (React Native, Flutter, native iOS/Android).

· Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and shipping production applications to the Apple App Store and/or Google Play Store.

· Hands-on experience with mobile architecture, API integration, authentication, secure storage, push notifications, testing, and performance optimization.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control (e.g., Git), code review processes, crash reporting, analytics, and production support.

· Track record of leading technical design decisions and mentoring engineering teams while remaining hands-on with code.

**React Native architecture:** Native modules, bridges or modern native integration patterns, New Architecture, platform-specific implementations, and dependency management.

**Performance and scalability:** App startup, memory, rendering, network efficiency, battery usage, and smooth media playback.

**Mobile infrastructure:** Build signing, provisioning profiles, certificates, environment configurations, OTA updates where appropriate, and automated release pipelines.

**Security and abuse prevention:** Secure token handling, certificate/network security where appropriate, application integrity checks, and protection against automated abuse.

**Advanced integrations:** Video and audio, live streaming, payments, deep links, universal links, push notifications, and third-party SDKs.

**Production ownership:** Crash analysis, ANR monitoring, observability, phased rollouts, rollback planning, and app-store compliance.

**Cross-platform engineering:** Knowing when shared code is appropriate and when native iOS or Android implementations are necessary.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

· Relevant certifications in mobile development or cloud technologies are advantageous.

**SKILLS / BEHAVIOUR ATTRIBUTES**

· Deep expertise in React Native and/or cross-platform mobile frameworks (Flutter, Xamarin, etc.).

· Strong knowledge of mobile security, accessibility, automated UI testing, and performance tuning.

· Experience integrating AI-enabled features, real-time communications, payments, maps, or enterprise identity solutions is a plus.

· Excellent problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering secure, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product and engineering teams.

· Proactive leadership, mentoring, and team-building abilities.

· Adaptability to fast-paced, evolving technology environments and emerging industry trends.

**SALARY RANGE**

· Competitive and commensurate with experience and expertise. (Exact range to be discussed during the interview process.)

Pay: ₹545,000.00 - ₹1,950,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Job Description:**
**Mobile app Architect**

 **Core Skillset for Mobile App and Spring Boot Java**

 **Architecture documentation**

  

C4 diagrams, technical standards, architecture review reports.

 **Cloud/backend understanding**

  

AWS/Azure/GCP basics, API gateways, load balancing, caching, queues, databases, scalability

 **Mobile security**

  

OWASP MASVS/MSTG concepts, root/jailbreak considerations, secure logging, secrets, reverse engineering risks

 **Authentication \& security**

  

OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, refresh tokens, secure storage, certificate pinning where justified, biometric auth, session management

 **Spring Boot integration**

  

Should understand Spring Boot sufficiently to evaluate API contracts and mobile/backend interaction

 **API architecture**

  

REST/JSON, API versioning, pagination, error handling, retries, idempotency, WebSockets if applicable

 **Mobile architecture**

  

Clean Architecture, modularization, dependency management, separation of UI/domain/data layers, scalability

 **iOS \& Android**

  

Strong understanding of both platforms, including native build/configuration, permissions, push notifications, deep links, lifecycle, background tasks

title: Mobile Application Developer Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Mobile App Developer Intern** who is passionate about mobile application development and interested in gaining hands\-on experience by working on real\-world projects. The intern will work with our development team to build, test, and improve mobile applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in developing mobile applications for Android and/or iOS platforms.
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional mobile application interfaces.
* Develop new features and improve existing application functionality.
* Integrate **REST APIs and backend services**.
* Work with databases and application data.
* Perform testing and debugging of mobile applications.
* Identify and fix bugs and performance issues.
* Assist in implementing authentication, notifications, and other app features.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, and project managers.
* Maintain clean, organized, and reusable code.
* Participate in application deployment and maintenance activities.
* Learn and follow mobile development best practices.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of mobile application development.
* Knowledge of **Flutter / React Native / Android / iOS**.
* Basic programming knowledge in one or more of:
* Dart
* Java
* Kotlin
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Swift
* Basic understanding of **REST APIs and JSON**.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
* Understanding of basic UI/UX concepts.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.

Preferred Skills

* Basic experience with **Flutter or React Native**.
* Knowledge of Firebase.
* Understanding of push notifications.
* Basic knowledge of Google Maps or location services.
* Familiarity with mobile app testing.
* Knowledge of databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
* Personal or academic mobile application projects.

Educational Qualification

* B.E / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc Computer Science / IT or a related field.
* Students and recent graduates with relevant technical skills are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Learn

* Real\-world mobile application development.
* Flutter / React Native development.
* API integration and backend connectivity.
* Mobile UI development.
* Database integration.
* Debugging and application testing.
* Git and collaborative development.
* Mobile application deployment.
* Complete mobile app development lifecycle.

Ideal Candidate

* Passionate about mobile application development.
* Eager to learn and work on real\-world projects.
* Strong logical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Able to work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks.

**Skills:** Flutter \| React Native \| Android \| iOS \| Dart \| Kotlin \| Java \| JavaScript \| REST API \| Firebase \| Git \| Mobile UI/UX

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
